```ts
//
// A fine-grained reactive system, inspired by
// ... links ...
//

type EqualFn<T> = (lhs: T, rhs: T) => boolean
type GetterFn<T> = () => T
type SetterFn<T> = (value: T) => T
type UnsubscribeFn = () => void
type UpdateFn<T> = (value?: T) => T

type InputPair<T> = [GetterFn<T>, SetterFn<T>]

type Options = {
  name: string // for debugging
}

type CellKind = 'input' | 'computed' | 'callback'

/**
 * Internal representation ...
 */
type Cell = {
  name?: string
  kind: CellKind
  value: unknown
  update?: (previous: unknown) => unknown
  equal?: (lhs: unknown, rhs: unknown) => boolean
  sources: Set<Cell>
  observers: Set<Cell>
  // bookkeeping for a single propagation round
  mark: number
  resolved: boolean
  resolving: boolean
  propagated: boolean
}

let activeCell: Cell | undefined
let round = 0

function makeEqual<T>(equal?: boolean | EqualFn<T>): ((lhs: unknown, rhs: unknown) => boolean) | undefined {
  if (typeof equal === 'function') return (lhs, rhs) => equal(lhs as T, rhs as T)
  if (equal === true) return (lhs, rhs) => lhs === rhs
  return undefined
}

function newCell<T>(kind, value: T | undefined, update: UpdateFn<T> | undefined, equal: boolean | EqualFn<T> | undefined, name?: string): Cell {
  return {
    kind, value, update: update ? (previous) => update(previous as T) : undefined,
    equal: makeEqual(equal), sources: new Set(), observers: new Set(),
    mark: 0, resolved: false, resolving: false, propagated: false, name,
  }
}
```
